title: Abandoned Cabin

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Abandoned Cabins are Points of interest found in the Mountain biome. They are dilapidated buildings made mostly of Log structures.

sections.heading: Resources
sections.text:
They come in three variants. Each have a chance for the following feature:
• A chance for a Mountain Chest, notably containing Onion seeds and Valuables.
• A chance for Stone Golems to spawn once.
• A chance for Skeletons to spawn once.

Introduction. Abandoned Cabins are Points of interest found in the Mountain biome. They are dilapidated buildings made mostly of Log structures.

Resources. They come in three variants. Each have a chance for the following feature:
• A chance for a Mountain Chest, notably containing Onion seeds and Valuables.
• A chance for Stone Golems to spawn once.
• A chance for Skeletons to spawn once.
